meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 装上后,当你说要发布时,Claude 会执行完整的发布流程:触发 GitHub 自动构建,等待成功,生成发布说明,发到 Discord,核对 npm 版本,最后确认。它不会在发布时审查代码,除非你明确要求。
howto.when: 当你说出 'publish'、'release'、'deploy' 等关键词,并给出要发布的版本档位(如 patch、minor、major 或具体版本号)时触发。

say.note: 触发 patch 档位的发布流程。

say.text: 帮我发布一个 minor 版本
say.note: 按 minor 档位发布新功能。
按指定版本号发布预发布版。

howto.what_en: When asked to publish, Claude runs the full release flow: triggers the GitHub Actions build, waits for success, writes release notes, posts to Discord, verifies npm versions, and confirms. It does not review code during publishing unless asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'publish', 'release', 'deploy', etc., and specify a release selector such as patch, minor, major, or an explicit version number.

say_en.note: Claude will run the patch release flow.

say_en.text: Release a minor version for me
say_en.note: Claude will publish a minor release with new features.
Claude will publish that explicit prerelease version.
